name: TeamStarWolf - Fancy Bear Goes Phishing Cases
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. ATT&CK techniques that the verified record supports for the five cases in Fancy Bear Goes Phishing: the Morris worm (1988), the Dark Avenger viruses (1989 to 1992), the 2005 phone case, the DNC intrusions by APT28 and APT29 (2015 to 2016) and Mirai (2016). Each comment names the case and source numbers from case-studies/FANCY_BEAR_GOES_PHISHING_CASES.md. Scores: 100 is a technique the opened record or ATT&CK states for the DNC actors, 50 is a mapping that needs an interpretive step, including every row for the four cases ATT&CK does not cover.

legendItems.label: 100: stated by the opened record or ATT&CK
